title: Library and Information Technology
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Library and Information Technology - A.S. Degree Major/Cert. Achievement (18 units or more)
outcomes: Students will be able to accurately use acquisitions techniques as well as current cataloging and classification systems to order and process library materials.
Students will be able to apply the basic principles of reference, information literacy, information services, and collection development in order to select appropriate resources and assist patrons.
Students will be able to function effectively in the areas of circulation, interlibrary loan and collection maintenance.
Students will be able to identify, evaluate and effectively use library technologies, including emerging and assistive technologies, to inform, educate and serve library patrons.
Students will be able to recommend appropriate strategies for teaching others to evaluate information sources.
Students will understand and be able to describe the mission and roles of a library in its community, and the mission of libraries in general.

notes: The catalog prints one combined section for the A.S. Degree Major and the Certificate of Achievement; the certificate shares the same requirements (24 units) and the same learning outcomes list.
LT 105 is titled 'Library Program Planning, Marketing, and Assessment' in the catalog, but the closed list names it 'Research Skills & Informed Learning'; reviewer should confirm the code match.
LT 140 is marked '( Historical )' in the catalog while still listed as required.
